# connection

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/grafana/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/grafana/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

The Grafana local connection — its native configuration, the `grafana.service_account` profile and the configured identity probe that proves a service-account token.

`connectors_grafana.connection` is one of connectors_grafana's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `IdentityProbe`

`connectors_grafana.connection.IdentityProbe` is a record of four fields:

- `method` — `String`
- `path` — `String`
- `source` — `connectors_grafana.connection.IdentitySource`
- `kind` — `String`

Every value satisfies `method == "GET"`, `path == "api/datasources"` and `kind == "grafana.connection"`.

### `IdentitySource`

`connectors_grafana.connection.IdentitySource` is one of `configuration`.

### `InstanceId`

`connectors_grafana.connection.InstanceId` wraps `String` and is not interchangeable with one: the whole value of naming it separately is the crossings the model then refuses. Its characters are drawn from `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_.-`. Every value satisfies `(value.count >= 1 and value.count <= 128)`.

### `LocalConfiguration`

`connectors_grafana.connection.LocalConfiguration` is a record of four fields:

- `format` — `String`
- `instance` — `connectors_grafana.connection.InstanceId`
- `base_url` — `String`
- `ca_file` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `format == "connectors-grafana-local/1"`, `(base_url.count >= 8 and base_url.count <= 512)`, `base_url starts_with "https://"` and `(ca_file.count >= 1 and ca_file.count <= 4096)`.

### `ServiceAccountEntry`

`connectors_grafana.connection.ServiceAccountEntry` is a record of one field:

- `token` — `connectors_grafana.connection.ServiceAccountToken`

### `ServiceAccountProfile`

`connectors_grafana.connection.ServiceAccountProfile` is a record of nine fields:

- `id` — `String`
- `scheme` — `String`
- `capability` — `String`
- `purpose` — `String`
- `subject` — `String`
- `minimum_scopes` — `List<String>`
- `evidence_lifetime_ms` — `Integer`
- `entry` — `String`
- `identity` — `connectors_grafana.connection.IdentityProbe`

Every value satisfies `id == "grafana.service_account"`, `scheme == "http_bearer"`, `capability == "http-bearer"`, `purpose == "service_account"`, `subject == "app"`, `minimum_scopes.count == 0`, `evidence_lifetime_ms == 60000` and `entry == "connectors_grafana.connection.ServiceAccountEntry"`.

### `ServiceAccountToken`

`connectors_grafana.connection.ServiceAccountToken` wraps `String` and is not interchangeable with one: the whole value of naming it separately is the crossings the model then refuses. Its characters are drawn from `!"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\{|\}~`. Every value satisfies `(value.count >= 1 and value.count &lt;= 8192)`.

Three of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_grafana.connection.LocalConfiguration`, `connectors_grafana.connection.ServiceAccountEntry` and `connectors_grafana.connection.ServiceAccountProfile`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
